parsed_json.up: Select distinct molecule ChEMBL identifiers and canonical SMILES for compounds tested against human Interleukin-1 receptor-associated kinase 4 (IRAK4). Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then assays, then target_dictionary. Filter by exact match on target_dictionary.pref_name. Join compound_structures as an inner join to require canonical SMILES. Sort results by molecule ChEMBL identifier.
